candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The Nusselt number (Nu) is a dimensionless number representing the ratio of convective to conductive heat transfer across a fluid layer. It is dimensionless by definition, so all SI exponents are zero.

variables.physical_definition: Height of the container, a length scale of the fluid layer.
Temperature difference between the top and bottom surfaces of the fluid layer.
